WHILE TRUE
wait 0
    
    // SCENARY 00 - VICE CRIME 
    IF
        $SCENARY_LOADED == 0
    THEN
        IF
            Char.LocateAnyMeans3D($scplayer, -1981.3473, 1228.4783, 31.2478, 35.0, 35.0, 36.0, 0)
        THEN
            $SCENARY_LOADED = 1
            goto @LOOTS_SC00  
        END
    ELSE
        IF
            Object.DoesExist($CORPSE00)
        THEN
            IF
                Car.DoesExist($CAR00)
            THEN
                IF
                    Object.DoesExist($GUN)
                THEN
                    Object.Delete($CORPSE00)
                    Object.Delete($GUN)
                    Car.Delete($CAR00)
                    $SCENARY_LOADED = 0
                    Debugger.Trace("SCENARIES: 00 UNLOADED")
                END
            END
        END
    END
END

    END

/////// Music Handler

:MUSIC
script_name 'MUSIC'

:MUSIC_11
wait 0
IF
    {0256:}   is_player_playing $player1
jf @MUSIC_11
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Player detected")

:MUSIC_CHECK
wait 0

WHILE TRUE
wait 0

    // Reset the music if the player ever dies
    IF
        {0118:}   is_char_dead {handle} $scplayer
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_RESET
    END
    
    // If the player gets a wanted level give him the WL music instead
    IF
        Player.IsWantedLevelGreater(0, 0)
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_WL_32
    END
    
    // Variable to control whether there's music playing in a cutscene or not
    IF
        $CAN_PLAY_MUSIC == 0
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_HOLD
    END
    
    // MAIN: If there's not music playing - get to it
    IF
        $IS_MUSIC_PLAYING == 0
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_32
    END
    
    // If there is a mission song playing - wipe the WHOLE system and wait
    IF
        $PLAY_SOUNDTRACK_ID <> -1
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_RESET
    END
END

:MUSIC_32
wait 0
gosub @GET_AM_MUSIC 

:MUSIC_64   // Play music with fade-in effect and applied timing
wait 0
$randomInt = Math.RandomIntInRange(3500, 5001)
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Range generated")
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Generated range: %i", $randomInt)

:MUSIC_PLAYIT
wait $randomInt   //  Interval where the music will start to play (in milisec.)
gosub @LOWER_WL
$IS_MUSIC_WL_PLAYING = 0
$IS_MUSIC_PLAYING = 1
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.8 {timeMs} 1000
{0AAD:} set_audio_stream_state $hOGG {action} 1
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Playing song")
wait 100

// Manage AM Music

:MUSIC_SOUNDTRACK_CHECK
wait 0
IF
    $PLAY_SOUNDTRACK_ID <> -1
jf @MUSIC_ONCAR_STOPIT
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Mission Music Detected - Restarting")
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.0 {timeMs} 1000
jump @MUSIC_RESET

:MUSIC_ONCAR_STOPIT
wait 0
051E: $cradio = get_current_radio_station
IF AND
    $IS_MUSIC_PLAYING == 1
    not $cradio == 12
    00DF:   actor $scplayer driving
jf @MUSIC_ONCAR_RESUME
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Paused by car radio")
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.0 {timeMs} 1000
wait 100
0AAD: set_audio_stream $hOGG state 2       
$IS_MUSIC_PLAYING = 0
$IS_MUSIC_WL_PLAYING = 0
                 
:MUSIC_ONCAR_RESUME
wait 0
051E: $cradio = get_current_radio_station
IF AND
    $IS_MUSIC_PLAYING == 0
    00DF:   actor $scplayer driving
    $cradio == 12    
jf @MUSIC_ENDED
$IS_MUSIC_PLAYING = 1
$IS_MUSIC_WL_PLAYING = 0
gosub @LOWER_WL
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Music resumed")
0AAD: set_audio_stream $hOGG state 3
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.8 {timeMs} 1000
wait 100
jump @MUSIC_SOUNDTRACK_CHECK

:MUSIC_ENDED
wait 0
0AB9: get_audio_stream $hOGG state_to 7@
IF
    $IS_MUSIC_PLAYING == 1    
jf @MUSIC_ISWANTED
IF
    7@ == -1
jf @MUSIC_ISWANTED
wait 1500
jump @MUSIC_RESET

:MUSIC_ISWANTED
wait 0

    Player.IsWantedLevelGreater($player1, 0)
jf @MUSIC_ONCAR_STOPIT
wait 100
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Restarting music due to wanted level detected")
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.0 {timeMs} 1000
wait 100
$IS_MUSIC_PLAYING = 0
jump @MUSIC_WL_32

:MUSIC_RESET
$IS_MUSIC_PLAYING = 0
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $hOGG {volume} 0.0 {timeMs} 500
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: Full system reset")
jump @MUSIC_11

:MUSIC_HOLD
Debugger.Trace("MUSIC: AM Music On Hold")
{2504:} set_audio_stream_volume_with_transition $SOUNDTRACK {volume} 0.0 {timeMs} 1000
WHILE TRUE
wait 0
    IF
        $CAN_PLAY_MUSIC == 1
    THEN
        goto @MUSIC_CHECK
    END
END
goto @MUSIC_CHECK

/// LOOP 1 - IDLE RECORDING
WHILE TRUE
wait 0

    // PLAYER CHECK    
    IF OR
        {0741:}   has_char_been_arrested $scplayer
        {0118:}   is_char_dead {handle} $scplayer
    THEN

    END
    
    // CAR CHECK    
    IF
        {0119:}   is_car_dead {handle} $VEH_STRYKER
    THEN
        goto @GALE_C1_3_FAIL5
    END 
    
    IF
        $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG == 0
    THEN
        IF
            AUDIO_HAS_STARTED == 0
        THEN
            // Appear the TB
            IF
                 not Text.IsThisHelpMessageBeingDisplayed("PIP@04")
            THEN
                Text.PrintHelpForever("PIP@04")   
            END
            
            IF
                Pad.IsButtonPressed(0, 4)
            THEN
                $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG = 1
                AUDIO_HAS_STARTED = 1
                Audiostream3D.Remove($SFX) 
                Audiostream3D.Load("AUDIO\STRND\SFX\MISC\RECORDER_TEMP.ogg", SFX)
                Audiostream3D.SetPlayAtObject(SFX, RADIO)
                Audiostream3D.SetVolume(SFX, $GAME_SFX_VOLUME)
                Audiostream3D.SetState(SFX, 1)
                Text.ClearHelp()
                
                IF
                    $DIALOG_MODE <= 0
                THEN
                    $DIALOG_MODE = 1
                END
                
                {004F:} start_new_script @M15DIAG
                goto @GALE_C1_3_740
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF
        AUDIO_HAS_STARTED == 1
    THEN
        wait 250
        AUDIO_HAS_STARTED = 0
    END
END

/// LOOP 2 - PLAYING RECORDING
:GALE_C1_3_740
wait 0

WHILE TRUE
wait 0

    // PLAYER CHECK    
    IF OR
        {0741:}   has_char_been_arrested $scplayer
        {0118:}   is_char_dead {handle} $scplayer
    THEN
        goto @GALE_C1_3_FAIL1
    END
    
    // CAR CHECK    
    IF
        {0119:}   is_car_dead {handle} $VEH_STRYKER
    THEN
        goto @GALE_C1_3_FAIL5
    END 
    
    IF
        $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG == 1
    THEN
        // PAUSE THE RECORDING
        IF
             not Text.IsThisHelpMessageBeingDisplayed("PIP@05")
        THEN
            Text.PrintHelpForever("PIP@05")   
        END
        
        IF AND
            $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG == 1
            Pad.IsButtonJustPressed(0, 4)
        THEN
            $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG = 0
            AUDIO_HAS_STARTED = 1
            
            Audiostream3D.Remove($SFX) 
            Audiostream3D.Load("AUDIO\STRND\SFX\MISC\RECORDER_TEMP.ogg", SFX)
            Audiostream3D.SetPlayAtObject(SFX, RADIO)
            Audiostream3D.SetVolume(SFX, $GAME_SFX_VOLUME)
            Audiostream3D.SetState(SFX, 1)
            
            IF
                $DIALOG_MODE > 0
            THEN
                $DIALOG_MODE += -1
            ELSE
                $DIALOG_MODE = 1
            END
            
            Text.ClearHelp()
            {00BE:} clear_prints
            {0459:} terminate_all_scripts_with_this_name {name} 'M15DIAG'
            wait 1200
            goto @GALE_C1_3_630
        END
    END
    
    // THE RECORDING HAS FINISHED NATURALLY
    IF
        $RECORDING_STATUS_FLAG == 2
    THEN
        Text.ClearHelp()
        {00BE:} clear_prints
        {0459:} terminate_all_scripts_with_this_name {name} 'M15DIAG'
        IF
            not Blip.DoesExist(LOCATION_BLIP)
        THEN
            {018A:} LOCATION_BLIP = add_blip_for_coord -1843.9526 -1651.0804 21.75
        END
        GXT_DISPLAYED = 0
        wait 1200
        goto @GALE_C1_3_1000
    END
    
END

                    case 2

        END
    END
    
    // QUICK SWITCH
    // HEAVY WEAPONS
    IF
        Pad.IsKeyJustPressed(49)
    THEN
        {04B8:} WeaponType, WeaponAmmo, WeaponModel = get_char_weapon_in_slot $scplayer {slot} 6
        Char.SetCurrentWeapon($scplayer, WeaponType)
    END
